subject: [PATCH 12/60] mm/vmscan: restrict reclaim to common memory

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The patch series introduces a new restriction on reclaim to only operate on common memory nodes. This change is intended to improve performance and reduce unnecessary work in certain scenarios.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series restricts reclaim to common memory by modifying the kswapd and direct reclaim logic to only operate on nodes marked as N_MEMORY_COMMON. This change aims to improve performance and reduce unnecessary work in certain scenarios.
